The '''church''' is a location found in the [[Graveyard]]. It remains locked until [[Nun]] appears.

== Sermon ==
Every {{Icon|Wrath|size=20}}, the [[Keeper]] can hold a sermon at the Church. Sermons spend {{Icon|Happiness|size=20}} and require {{Icon|Church Quality|size=15}}. The lower of the two determines how many parishioners attend. After every sermon, based on the parishioners, they left {{Item|Faith}} and money. 

== Repairs ==
After unlocking the Church, there are 4 blockages that must be cleared. Each blockage requires {{Item|Bronze Detail|1}}, {{Item|Board|1}}, and {{Mastery|Orange|2}} to be cleared.

== Blueprint Desk ==
'''{{Icon|Church Quality|size=15}} Church Quality''' can be increased by placing various decorations.
